Note.title: Note
Note.description: Metadata for an individual physics chapter PDF note sold in Class 11, Class 12, or JEE sections.

id.description: Unique document identifier for the note.

title.description: Display title of the chapter note PDF.

description.description: Detailed topic coverage and highlights of the note.

singlePriceInINR.description: Individual chapter PDF price in Indian Rupees.

bundlePriceInINR.description: Effective discounted unit price when purchased as part of a bundle pack.

pageCount.description: Number of pages inside the handwritten PDF.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was published.

NotePrivateStorage.title: NotePrivateStorage
NotePrivateStorage.description: Locked R2 object key metadata stored in notes/{noteId}/private/storage so buyers cannot access raw storage keys.

r2FileKey.description: Object key inside the private Cloudflare R2 bucket.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the R2 key was recorded.

Bundle.title: Bundle
Bundle.description: Combo pack grouping multiple uploaded notes within a single curriculum section at a discounted price.

id.description: Unique document identifier for the bundle.

title.description: Display title of the bundle pack.

description.description: Summary of what the bundle pack includes.

includedNoteIds.description: List of note IDs unlocked when purchasing this bundle.

bundlePriceInINR.description: Discounted bundle pack price in Indian Rupees.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the bundle was created.

Purchase.title: Purchase
Purchase.description: Server-verified Razorpay purchase record granting PDF access for one or more noteIds to a student.

purchaseId.description: Unique identifier for this verified purchase.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student buyer.

unlockedNoteIds.description: All note IDs unlocked by this single or bundle order.

section.description: Storefront section associated with the purchased item.

purchaseType.description: Whether the student bought a single note or a bundle pack.

itemId.description: ID of the purchased note or bundle.

itemTitle.description: Title of the purchased note or bundle.

purchasedAt.description: Server timestamp when payment verification succeeded.

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Trusted administrator access record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin.

email.description: Verified email address of the admin.

/notes/{noteId}.description: Public catalog of uploaded single chapter physics PDF notes.

/notes/{noteId}/private/{docId}.description: Admin-only private subcollection storing raw Cloudflare R2 object keys (docId = storage).

/bundles/{bundleId}.description: Public catalog of discounted section-specific note bundle packs.

/purchases/{purchaseId}.description: Server-verified student purchases; owner-only read and zero client writes.
